title: Smoky Chicken Italian Grill
description: A smoky chicken dish marinated in Italian-inspired flavors, grilled to perfection.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, smoky paprika, Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper.
Add lemon juice to the bowl and whisk until combined.
Place the chicken breasts in a large zip-top plastic bag or a shallow dish.
Pour the marinade over the chicken and massage to coat.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Remove the chicken from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
Grill the chicken for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F.
Transfer the chicken to a cutting board and let rest for 5 minutes.
Slice the chicken against the grain and serve hot.
Optional: Grill some vegetables such as bell peppers, zucchini, and onions alongside the chicken.
